description:
FILED s522a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19) from the #3061 acceptance runs: Text-CSV-2.04's t/util.pl transpiles now, and 15 t/ files run rows they never ran.  Every row below was checked against TWO emulations under real perl 5.40.3 (scratch/s522a/fu/run.sh: utf8::is_utf8 forced to 1 = #1389; fu/run2.sh: that PLUS Text::CSV_PP's `%{$self->{_CACHE}} = %$ctx` stores removed = #3611) and is NOT reproduced by either -- so it is a different mechanism.  Outputs: scratch/s522a/csv/<file>.out in the s522a worktree.

SILENT WRONG rows, cause NOT isolated.  t/51_utf8.t rows 4 5 7 10 11 13 16 17 22 23 28 29 ("Unicode <layer> against Perl/expected"), 47 53 59 77 83 89 ("bytes dn/up <layer> against expected"), 129 132 135 139 151 154 157 161 173 176 179 183 (output / data from getline ()), and t/50_utf8.t row 64 "First field is binary" fail in PCL; real perl with both emulations passes them (the other 28 51_utf8 rows ARE #1389/#3611).  The rows compare a CSV round-trip through `:utf8` / `:encoding(UTF-8)` / binmode layers against perl's own split.  Related: #1389, #3515 (layer spelling).  NEXT STEP: minimise one "Unicode :utf8 against Perl" row.
subject: Text-CSV 51_utf8.t (30 rows) + 50_utf8.t row 64: the encoding-layer / binary-field rows fail where perl passes -- not #1389, not #3611
